title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description:
Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k`-th largest element in the array.

Note that it is the `k`-th largest element in sorted order, **not** the `k`-th distinct element. For example, in `[3, 2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 5, 5, 6]`, the 4th largest element is `4` because the sorted descending order is `[6, 5, 5, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1]`.

Can you solve it without sorting the entire array?
hints: Instead of sorting all n elements in O(n log n) time, think about maintaining only the k largest elements seen so far.
Use a min-heap of size at most k: push each element and pop the smallest whenever the heap exceeds size k.
After processing all elements, the root of the min-heap is the k-th largest element in O(n log k) time and O(k) space.

examples.explanation: In descending order [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1], the 2nd largest element is 5.
In descending order [6, 5, 5, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1], the 4th largest element is 4.
With a single element, the 1st largest element is -7.
